export.intro: Take your whole library with you: every original as you uploaded it, with what Mediarr knows about it.
export.whatIsIn: The export is made of ZIP files of up to 10 GB each: the originals by month, their XMP sidecars, a folder for each album and one JSON file with dates, places, descriptions, ratings, favourites, tags, people and edits. Passwords and keys are never in it. Files in an external library stay where they are and are only listed.
